ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, W, Y, and Z are on the same horizontal straight line, and Y is between W and Z; X is above this straight line. The line segments WX and XY have identical tick marks, indicating WX = XY, so △WXY is an isosceles triangle. Angle XYZ at Y is labeled 128°. Reasoning: Because YW and YZ are opposite rays on the same straight line, ∠WYX and ∠XYZ form a pair of supplementary adjacent angles. Given m∠XYZ = 128°, therefore m∠WYX = 180° - 128° = 52°. Also because WX = XY, the base angles of △WXY are equal, namely ∠XWY = ∠WYX = 52°. In △WXY, the sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, so ∠WXY = 180° - 52° - 52° = 76°.

raw_record.question_text: $\triangle WXY$ and $\triangle XYZ$ are isosceles and $m\angle XYZ = 128$. Find the measure of $\angle WXY$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: W, Y, and Z lie on one straight horizontal line with Y between W and Z; X is above the line; the matching tick marks show WX = XY for triangle WXY, and the angle labeled 128° is ∠XYZ. From the text, use that triangle WXY is isosceles and m∠XYZ = 128°. Since YW and YZ are opposite rays, ∠WYX and ∠XYZ form a linear pair, so ∠WYX = 180° - 128° = 52°. Because WX = XY, triangle WXY has equal base angles at W and Y, so ∠XWY = ∠WYX = 52°. Then apply the triangle angle sum in triangle WXY: ∠WXY = 180° - 52° - 52° = 76°.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic coordinate setup based on the diagram. Read from the image that W, Y, Z are collinear, Z is to the right of Y, X is above-left of Y, and the equal tick marks give XY = YZ and XW = XY. From the text, m∠XYZ = 128°. Set Y = (0,0), Z = (1,0), so XY = YZ = 1. Since ray YX makes a 128° angle with ray YZ, take X = (cos128°, sin128°). Let W = (t,0) on the line to the left of Y. The condition XW = XY = 1 gives (t - cos128°)^2 + (0 - sin128°)^2 = 1, so t = 2cos128° for the left-hand point W. Then compute ∠WXY using the dot product of vectors XY and XW: vectors from X are Y - X = (-cos128°, -sin128°) and W - X = (cos128°, -sin128°), both length 1. Their dot product is sin²128° - cos²128° = -cos256° = cos76°, so ∠WXY = 76°.

推理：按解析坐标法设置 Y = (0,0)，Z = (1,0)，所以 YZ = 1。因为 XY = YZ，所以 XY = 1。射线 YZ 沿正 x 轴，且 ∠XYZ = 128°，所以 X = (cos128°, sin128°)。设 W = (t,0)，且 W 在 Y 左侧。由 XW = 1 得 (t - cos128°)^2 + (0 - sin128°)^2 = 1。展开得 t^2 - 2t cos128° + cos^2 128° + sin^2 128° = 1，即 t^2 - 2t cos128° = 0，所以 t = 0 或 t = 2cos128°。t = 0 对应 W 与 Y 重合，不符合图形；cos128° < 0，因此 t = 2cos128° 是左侧的 W 点。于是从 X 出发的两个向量为 XY 向量 = Y - X = (-cos128°, -sin128°)，XW 向量 = W - X = (cos128°, -sin128°)。二者长度都为 1。点积为 (-cos128°)(cos128°) + (-sin128°)(-sin128°) = sin^2 128° - cos^2 128° = -cos256° = cos76°。因此 ∠WXY = 76°。
